premise: Each layer here is careful about itself. Nothing checks them against each other. Twenty artefacts make overlapping claims about the same diseases and the system has never been audited even though every part of it has.
caveat: A contradiction proves at least one layer is wrong without saying which. Where an authored layer contradicts a measured one the measured one is the better bet, but that is a prior, not a finding.

contradictions.says: two layers give this disease different ORPHA codes. One of them joins to a different disease, and every number computed through it is about that other disease.
the layers quote different bands, and Orphanet records all of them - this is the collapse-of-a-spread problem, not an error of fact
